notes.title: Train Jumble Playtest Update
notes.content:
On February 19th we made a first version of Train Jumble available to an audience beyond our small studio from Bayreuth / Germany. So firstly, it's time to say...
[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thank you very much for playtesting our first public version of Train Jumble. 256 people actively played the demo spending over 160 hours playtesting Train Jumble. We're a small studio with a small game but this is still something to be proud about! Thank you for spending your time, helping us make our game better!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/e8dba32779ec2eaa28ab7bd078eb9862e067ed4b.gif[/img]
Thank you for the 100 e-mails and discord messages you sent us with many constructive suggestions and ideas!
[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
With that said, we're introducing a first patch for the Train Jumble playtest and will give access to anyone who was still waiting!

We're introducing the following updates to the game:
[list]
[*] Unlimited action mode is now the default
[*] Each mission now has a reduced map, to make the routes more interesting. 
[*] Added option to sell items in your inventory
[*] Improved "next to X" desires for sideway seats
[*] Increased the AOE of the window-module
[*] Added a motion sickness mode that freezes the train in position (check the options to activate it)
[*] Added edge pan to move the camera on top of the normal WASD and Mouse wheel movement (can be disabled in the options)
[*] The next desires UI at the top, when in station, now only show what you are missing in your train and how many passengers want to get on your train. There is no penalty if not every passenger fits on the train. You can hover the UI to get more information.
[*] Added missing main menu music
[*] Added unlock counter to the main menu
[*] lots of small bug fixes and usability improvements
[/list]
We're curious how these changes affect gameplay and what you think! So head over to our Discord to discuss the changes and give us feedback!
[url=https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/7b22dd97e0946b229f326483358643560110ee43.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Game Announcement: Train Jumble
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/873c7faf367dda025116f8059ede38e01c5614d4.png[/img]

We're super excited to announce our second game [b]Train Jumble[/b] a game where you travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all your passengers are happy with their seats!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Train Jumble offers entertaining, non-violent, non-time-critical gameplay in a humorous setting. You have to move passengers so that they are happy with their seats and can add modules to your train at stations to make the journey more comfortable, more fun or more productive, depending on what the passengers want.
[list]
[*] Furnish your train
[*] Manage passengers
[*] Buy upgrades
[*] Travel Europe
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/40dbe63e6240f9458b77554da905c8999dba5dc9.gif[/img]

[h2]Public playtest February 19th[/h2]
You can [b]sign up[/b] for a first public playtest [b]starting today[/b]! Simply head to our steam page and click the button next to "wishlist" (wishlisting is very welcome too, of course ;) )
We're looking forward to share more updates about the game in the future and especially looking forward to your feedback from the playtest!
